full_text:
Fully autonomous social publishing is a dangerous recipe for brand reputational risk.

Unfiltered LLM outputs can introduce hallucinations or off-brand tone before anyone notices.

Integrating interactive Telegram Inline Keyboard buttons creates a 5-second human approval checkpoint right from your phone.

One tap on ✅ Approve & Schedule queue sends posts straight to LinkedIn API v2.

Do you allow 100% automated AI posting, or do you require human-in-the-loop validation?

#HumanInTheLoop #TelegramBot #LangGraph #Productivity #MNC
